The disease is rare under the age of 25, and increases in incidence with age, although the rate of increase slows af- ter the menopause. Risk factors include a family history (women with inherited BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations are at higher risk), and reproductive hormonal factors such as early menarche, late menopause, nulliparity, and older age at birth of first child.
